_comment: Frozen Terminal-Bench 2 iteration subset for the Phase 1 delta harness (T418). See docs/benchmarks/tb-subset.md for the full rationale. JSON has no comment syntax; this leading underscore-prefixed key is documentation only and MUST be ignored by any consumer (T419's runner reads the `tasks` array).
based_on: docs/plans/plan-035-roadmap-v7-ground-up.md §2.4 Phase 1, “Registered interpretation of the delta” block (predicted_effect tagging requirement, frozen at authoring time)
dataset_enumeration_method: harbor dataset download terminal-bench/terminal-bench-2 --export (git sparse-checkout of task packages; no Docker container was built or run to produce this enumeration or this file)
category_scheme: Verbatim `category` field from each task's own `task.toml` [metadata] section (Harbor/Terminal-Bench's own taxonomy, not an invented one). 16 distinct categories exist across the 89-task dataset; all 16 are represented in this subset.
freeze_policy: This subset is frozen once committed. Do not add, remove, or re-tag entries after T41A's first run for any reason, including a null/negative delta result — see plan-035 §2.4 Phase 1's “Consequences of a null delta, pre-committed” (“The subset is not re-cut, re-stratified, or extended to search for a positive. T418's freeze holds.”). A revision requires a new dated successor file, not an edit of this one.
predicted_effect_definition: positive = judged to require multi-step planning before execution (build/implement/debug/forensic-recovery tasks where the agent must design an approach before acting); neutral = judged closer to a single-command or lookup task (invoke one existing tool/script, or a largely mechanical translation/conversion). Tagged now, before any T41A measurement exists, per plan-035's registered-prediction requirement. Not revisited after seeing results.
